scheme_name: Vanchit Ikai Samooh Aur Vargon Ko Aarthik Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be a member of Backward Classes as notified by the Central or State Government (OBC eligibility).
Must be an OBC Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) cardholder or an OBC individual facing three or more deprivations according to SECC‑2011 records.
Must be involved in agricultural activities and covered under the PM KISAN scheme.
Self‑Help Groups must be registered with NRLM/NULM/NABARD and have a credit history of more than two years.
Must be a Self‑Help Group recognized by NSFDC and registered with NRLM/NULM/NABARD (SC eligibility).
Must belong to a Scheduled Caste as listed by the State or Central Government.
Must possess a valid Annual Income Certificate issued by the competent State authority.
Must be a Scheduled Caste AAY cardholder or an individual facing three or more deprivations according to SECC‑2011.
benefits_summary: Provides interest subvention of up to 5% per annum on loans up to ₹4 lakhs for SHGs and ₹2 lakhs for individuals, transferred directly to the borrower’s account.
documents_required: Prescribed application form for VISVAS Scheme
